name: Plugin 1.7.17 · Desktop 1.5.0
zh:
• 托盘与全局快捷键：可在关闭主窗口后保留在托盘，单击图标显示或隐藏，右键退出，悬停显示未读私聊数。可选全局快捷键（默认 Ctrl+Alt+X，可自定义）呼出窗口并直接聚焦输入框，窗口已在最前时再按一次隐藏。两项默认关闭，在“设置 → 窗口”开启。
  • 本设备密钥加密保存：客户端私钥改用 Windows DPAPI 按当前账户加密，首次启动自动迁移并替换旧的明文备份。
  • 插件默认只允许本机连接：新配置只监听 127.0.0.1；需要从局域网其他电脑连接时，在插件“连接”设置开启“允许局域网设备连接”。1.7.16 及更早的配置升级后自动保持开启，现有局域网连接不受影响；中继连接不受影响。
  • 限制重复确认窗口：同一地址最多 4 个未认证连接、同时 1 个待确认请求、每分钟最多 3 个，避免网络中未信任设备反复弹窗。
  • 客户端升级到 .NET 10（安装包自带运行时，无需另外安装）。

下载与升级

  • Windows 客户端：下载并解压 XIVChatNext-Desktop-v1.5.0-win-x64.zip 到新文件夹，关闭旧客户端后运行 XIVChat Desktop.exe。本地配置和历史会保留。
  • Dalamud 插件：从现有插件仓库更新至 1.7.17；手动开发加载可使用 latest.zip。
  • 中继无需更新，继续使用 1.7.15 中继发布包。
  • 私钥迁移后，旧版 1.4.x 客户端无法读取新配置。若可能回退，请先备份 %APPDATA%\XIVChat for Windows。

验证：147 项核心/存储检查、26 项更新检查、13 项插件网络限制检查、94 项 Windows 窗口检查通过；用户完成预览包实机测试并确认可发布。发布包由发布提交重新构建（仅版本号与文档不同），校验值见 SHA256SUMS.txt。
en:
• Tray and global shortcut: optionally keep running in the notification area when the main window closes. Click the icon to show or hide the window, right-click to exit, hover to see unread tells. An optional global shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+X by default, configurable) shows the window with the composer focused and hides it when it is already in front. Both are off by default; see Settings → Window.
  • Protected device key: the client's private key is encrypted with Windows DPAPI for the current user. Existing configurations migrate on first start, and the plain-text backup is replaced.
  • Same-PC connections by default: new plugin configurations listen on 127.0.0.1 only. To connect from another computer on your network, turn on Allow LAN connections in the plugin's Connection settings. Configurations from 1.7.16 or earlier keep LAN access turned on. Relay connections are unaffected.
  • Fewer repeated trust prompts: each address may hold 4 unauthenticated connections, 1 pending trust prompt and 3 prompts per minute.
  • The client now runs on .NET 10; the package remains self-contained.

Extract XIVChatNext-Desktop-v1.5.0-win-x64.zip into a new folder, close the previous client and run XIVChat Desktop.exe. Update the Dalamud plugin to 1.7.17, or extract latest.zip for developer loading. The relay is unchanged; use the existing relay deployment assets. After the key migration, 1.4.x clients cannot read the configuration; back up %APPDATA%\XIVChat for Windows first if you may roll back.

Validation: 147 core/storage, 26 update, 13 plugin network and 94 Windows UI checks passed, followed by user-confirmed live testing of the preview packages. Release packages were rebuilt from the release commit (version numbers and documentation only); checksums are included in SHA256SUMS.txt.

name: Plugin 1.7.16 · Desktop 1.4.0
zh:
• 修复国服丢消息：物品链接不再因读取不到英文资料导致整条聊天丢失；物品、地图附加资料或格式化失败时仍保留聊天文字。
  • 好友备注名与主播模式：支持独立备注名、隐藏自己或其他玩家，并覆盖聊天小窗、历史、收藏、通知、复制与导出。补齐中文角色名、跨服姓名和感情动作的隐藏。
  • 游戏符号面板：发送按钮旁可选择游戏内特殊符号，在光标处插入，不会自动发送。
  • 聊天显示修复：断线消息不再穿过聊天区域覆盖输入框，修复大量消息到达时小窗暂时空白。

下载与升级

  • Windows 客户端：下载并解压 XIVChatNext-Desktop-v1.4.0-win-x64.zip，运行其中的 XIVChat Desktop.exe。
  • Dalamud 插件：从现有插件仓库更新至 1.7.16；手动开发加载可使用 latest.zip 解压后的 XIVChatNext.dll。
  • 中继无需更新，部署文件继续使用 1.7.15 中继发布包。
  • 客户端升级会在历史数据库从 v5 迁移到 v6 前自动备份。回退时需同时恢复旧配置和旧数据库。
  • 之前未被插件记录的消息无法自动追回。主播模式不改写本地原始记录，游戏截图、输入框和无法识别的自由文本不会自动打码。

验证：147 项核心/存储检查、68 项 Windows 窗口检查、7 项国服插件数据检查通过；用户完成实机复测并确认可发布。发布包与实测包一致，校验值见 SHA256SUMS.txt。
en:
• Fixed CN item-link messages disappearing when an English data sheet was unavailable. Optional item/map metadata failures and formatting errors now preserve chat text.
  • Added contact nicknames and persistent streamer mode across chat, popouts, history, favorites, notifications, copy and exports, including Chinese names, cross-world names and linked emotes.
  • Added a game-symbol picker beside Send. Symbols replace the selection or insert at the cursor without sending.
  • Fixed disconnected chat overflowing into the composer and temporary blank popouts during message bursts.

Download and extract XIVChatNext-Desktop-v1.4.0-win-x64.zip for Windows. Update the Dalamud plugin to 1.7.16, or extract latest.zip for developer loading. The relay is unchanged; use the existing relay deployment assets.

History migration from v5 to v6 creates a backup; rollback requires the previous configuration and database. Previously unrecorded messages cannot be recovered automatically. Streamer mode leaves original local history intact and does not redact game screenshots, input fields or unrecognized free text.

Validation: 147 core/storage checks, 68 Windows UI checks and 7 CN plugin-data checks passed, followed by user-confirmed live retesting. These are the tested packages; checksums are included in SHA256SUMS.txt.

name: XIVChat Next Desktop 1.4.1
zh:
• 新增启动后后台更新检查，发现新版时在主窗口显示可关闭的提醒。
  • 新增“设置 → 更新”：手动检查、查看当前版本、更新说明与 Windows 客户端下载入口；可关闭启动检查，设置立即保存。
  • 正确区分客户端和插件版本，跳过草稿、预发布和仅插件更新。检查失败不影响聊天，不发送角色或聊天信息。
  • 下载在浏览器中打开，程序不会自动替换正在运行的客户端。

升级

下载 XIVChatNext-Desktop-v1.4.1-win-x64.zip，解压到新文件夹，关闭旧客户端后运行 XIVChat Desktop.exe。本地配置和历史会保留。1.4.0 及更早客户端需要手动下载这次更新，之后即可使用内置检查。

插件继续使用 1.7.16（插件下载与说明）；中继无需更新（现有部署包）。

验证：26 项更新检测测试、80 项 Windows 窗口回归通过，并验证了公开 GitHub 发布接口。发布使用同一份已测试安装包，校验值见 SHA256SUMS.txt。
en:
• Added a background startup update check and a dismissible main-window reminder.
  • Added Settings → Updates with manual checks, the current version, release notes and Windows download links. Startup checks can be disabled; the preference saves immediately.
  • Compare stable desktop ZIP versions independently of plugin tags. Ignore drafts, prereleases and plugin-only releases. Failed checks do not interrupt chat, and checks send no character or chat information.
  • Downloads open in your browser; the running client is never replaced automatically.

Download and extract XIVChatNext-Desktop-v1.4.1-win-x64.zip into a new folder, close the previous client and run XIVChat Desktop.exe. Local settings and history are retained. Clients on 1.4.0 or earlier must download this update manually to gain the built-in checker.

Continue using plugin 1.7.16. The relay deployment is unchanged.

Validation: 26 update checks and 80 Windows UI checks passed, plus a read-only check against the public GitHub release API. This is the tested package; checksums are included in SHA256SUMS.txt.

name: XIVChat Next 1.7.15 · Desktop 1.3.6
zh:
XIVChat Next 带来全新的 FFXIV 桌面聊天工作台，让会话整理、消息回顾和游戏连接更加方便。

  • 全新聊天工作台： 整理会话与频道，支持固定收件人悄悄话、未读计数，以及游戏同步好友列表和可选头像。
  • 本地消息管理： 按角色保存历史，支持关键词搜索、收藏、备注和导出。
  • 更丰富的聊天内容： 物品与地图卡片、装备对比，以及游戏截图的预览、保存和复制。
  • 灵活的窗口与布局： 独立聊天小窗、布局保存、事件通知和首次使用引导。
  • 支持直连与远程连接： 保留直连方式，新增可选自建中继，支持加密传输、持久配对和中英文网页管理后台。
  • 中英文支持： 界面与使用指南提供英文和简体中文，插件新配置默认英文。

本次包含 插件 1.7.15 和 Windows 桌面客户端 1.3.6。
en:
XIVChat Next brings a new desktop chat workspace to FFXIV, with more ways to organize conversations, revisit messages and stay connected to your game.

  • A new chat workspace: organized conversations and channels, fixed-recipient tells, unread counts, and a game-synced friend list with optional avatars.
  • Your messages, kept locally: character-specific history, keyword search, favorites, notes and export.
  • More context in chat: item and map cards, equipment comparisons, and game screenshots with preview, save and copy actions.
  • A workspace that fits you: separate chat windows, saved layouts, event notifications and first-run guidance.
  • Connect nearby or remotely: direct connections remain available, alongside an optional self-hosted relay with encrypted transport, saved pairing and English/Chinese web administration.
  • English and Simplified Chinese: bilingual interfaces and guides, with English as the default for new plugin configurations.

Includes plugin 1.7.15 and Windows desktop client 1.3.6.

name: XIVChat Next Desktop 1.3.7
zh:
• 修复副屏上的主窗口和聊天小窗在恢复布局时跑到屏幕外的问题。
  • 已保存的屏幕外窗口位置会自动恢复到可见区域。
  • 重启客户端后，窗口位置仍能正确恢复。

在 Assets 中下载 XIVChatNext-Desktop-v1.3.7-win-x64.zip，解压到新文件夹使用。本次桌面端更新兼容 插件 1.7.15，已有配置、历史和配对信息可继续使用。

插件与可选中继下载 · 客户端指南
en:
• Fixed main windows and chat popouts reopening outside the screen on a secondary monitor.
  • Saved off-screen window positions now return to the visible display area automatically.
  • Window positions remain correct after restarting the client.

Download XIVChatNext-Desktop-v1.3.7-win-x64.zip from Assets and extract it into a new folder. This desktop update works with plugin 1.7.15; your existing configuration, history and pairing remain available.

Plugin and optional relay downloads · Client guide
